main_text.head: IN Summam Controversiarum VIRI CLARISSIMI D. D. JOHANNIS HOORNBEEK, Theologiae in Illustri, quae Lugd. Batav. est, Academiâ Professoris eminentissimi.
main_text.p: Aeternus obductis quaeritur Lux Alma tenebris Tartareâ se fulse meri, strepitusque nefandos.

p.i: Ætherea ne damnare minus, prob numina gentem.

l.i: Sic se Erebi ostens aut acies, sauceque dolique
Et quicquid nex dira parit. Vesana libido
Heu! demissis grassatur agris, nec meta furori est.
Quis mihi Cajanos, Alogos, Bassosque; Secundosque
Nota) Dietrepbi, Garthaeis, ac fata Menandri?
Quis mihi vel fando memoret Barbasq;, Naetosque,
Impatiens mens horret adhuc. Si Tartara plaudant
Ut vis est vesana illis, si vincere cordi est
Et Domini calcare acies longo ordine, gyris
Inflexis, nec scire modum; Tu surgis in hostes
Impavidus, vir magne, truces, & vindice coelo
Sicque alios, Te ipse beas. Nihil arma Pelagi
Mentibus officiunt cautis, nihil arma Socini

page.notes: The initial woodcut letter "A" is decorative; the first word "Aeternus" is joined to it. Several words in the italic verse are damaged and uncertain (e.g. "sauceque", "Dietrepbi", "Naetosque", "Barbasq;"), and the scan is blurred; these readings are best effort. Dots and specks on the page are not printed text.
